EasyZoning.Zone_Controller.ToolDescripti:
This opens the EZ update roads panel.
Shortcut: Ctrl+V default (see Options menu).
EasyZoning.NewRoads.Tooltip.Both: Both sides. Click again for None.
EasyZoning.NewRoads.Tooltip.Left: Left side only. Click again for None.
EasyZoning.NewRoads.Tooltip.Right: Right side only. Click again for None.
EasyZoning.ExistingRoads.Tooltip.Both: Both sides. Click again for None. Red preview = remove.
EasyZoning.ExistingRoads.Tooltip.Left: Left side only. Click again for None. Right-click cycles zones.
EasyZoning.ExistingRoads.Tooltip.Right: Right side only. Click again for None. Right-click cycles zones.
